ops.body: Fixed by the cut with the exact remedy demanded: the store open takes the singleton lock and returns durable.ErrLockBusy (internal/proc/store.go:101-118); Serve maps it (serve.go:164-172); probeIncumbent's comment states the exclusion outright (serve.go:392-396). OwnProcesses against a serving daemon's RecordPath now refuses instead of killing its live children.
